_comment: Copy to /etc/pcoin/wpcn-pay.json, chmod 600. Every field below is required; the service refuses to start rather than guess one.
_token: The wPCN BEP-20 contract on BNB Smart Chain.
_payTo: The address customers send wPCN to. Use a DEDICATED address, not the inventory wallet -- revenue and float must not share a balance, or you cannot tell what you have sold.
_decimals: wPCN is 8 decimals, NOT the 18 that almost every BEP-20 uses. Getting this wrong misprices by 10^10.
_minConfirmations: BSC finalises in roughly 15 blocks (~45s). This is not the PCN rails' 3 -- different chain, different risk.
_bonusPercent: Extra credit for paying in wPCN rather than PCN. ZERO since 2026-09-11: wPCN is a 1:1 claim on PCN and should credit like one. It was 10, as a demand lever meant to force a PancakeSwap buy, but the wrap desk sells wPCN for a 5% fee so the bonus could be collected by wrapping coins you already held -- a +9.5% round trip that created no demand at all. Before setting this above the wrap fee again, work out who can mint the input cheaper than the bonus is worth.
_rpcUrls: Tried in order. Public endpoints rate-limit; more than one is not optional. An exhausted list is an error, never an empty answer.
_port: NOT 8791 -- that is wrapdesk.pc.am on 178.105.3.51, and binding over it would take the wrap desk down. Check with `ss -lnt` before choosing.
_bind: Loopback. Put it behind the web server you already run; do not publish this port. Three services on 116.203.221.42 were reachable from the internet for exactly this reason.
_clients: Bearer token -> project name. The name is written onto every claim, so the ledger says which project banked which payment. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
